publicCredit: Matiss Skujins. Portfolio preview for SIRO One Za’abeel.
creditLimit: The portfolio identifies the creator and project but does not specify an individual direction, camera or editing role. No such role is asserted.

inspection.visual: Frame at three seconds inspected: a hotel suite with dining and lounge areas, large windows and the Dubai skyline. No baked-in black bars visible in that frame. It is suitable as hospitality proof.
inspection.completeness: Short portfolio preview, not the complete campaign film. Displayed and described as an excerpt.
